title: Counting values in an indexed list
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ assign an element of a type to each index $i\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $a$ be an element of that type. The number of occurrences of $a$ in the list of values of $f$ equals the number of indices $i<n$ for which $f(i)=a$.
hypotheses_covered: A function $f$ from indices $i<n$ to a type
